title: SiteDetail - Data API
description: Represents the details of a Salesforce site or Experience Cloud site. Available in API Version 38.0 and later.

DurableId.description: The ID of the Site object.

IsRegistrationEnabled.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsRegistrationEnabled.description: Indicates whether the site allows users to sign up.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="SiteDetail">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="DurableId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="IsRegistrationEnabled" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="SecureUrl" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
